about: VYVAR camera catalog (CAMERA-PROFILE-2026-10): CMOS cameras used for photometry - cooled models of all major vendors plus uncooled fast mono models (global shutter / occultation sensors). Typical manufacturer values; every curve point names its source; values the vendor does not publish as numbers are left out. header_gain: what the FITS GAIN card means (e_per_adu = effective e-/ADU, setting = driver gain setting). binning (only when documented): average (gain x N^2, read noise x N), sum (gain x 1, read noise x N), charge (both x 1). e_per_adu is in native ADC units of the mode (adc_bits). Measured or manual points of your own camera always win.
